title: CallsFromTypeForSelectiveForward
description:
* `ANY_PHONE_NUMBER` - The schedule applies to any phone number.
 * `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS` - The schedule applies to select phone number defined in the `phoneNumbers` property.
 * `ANY_INTERNAL` - The schedule applies to any internal phone number.
 * `ANY_EXTERNAL` - The schedule applies to any external phone number.
